{{Top}}
[[File:HWK290-XWMG.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290]] light freighter]]
{{Quote|Garvan's knees&mdash;there's more kinds a light freighters limpin' around than you've got hairs&mdash;uh, scales&hellip;Heck, ever'body who owns one of the blasted t'ings messes wit' it in some way. Vair's eyelids&mdash;none of 'em are 'stock' anymore.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rars Lefken]]|<ref name="Secrets of the Sisar Run">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>}}
'''Light freighters''' were spacecraft used for small [[Freighter/Legends|freight]] operations. They were popular choices for small shipping firms, independent haulers and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] for their low cost, ease of customization and a ubiquitous nature that helped avoid unwanted attention.

These craft were usually upgradeable, a glistening (or maybe a not-so-glistening) example being the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which was capable of moving four times as fast in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] as a stock [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]].

Although light freighters were usually in private hands, the [[Azzameen family]] used a few [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]] transports for their shipping operations. Most large shipping concerns used larger [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] and [[Container ship/Legends|container ships]] for their transportation needs.
